description:
Get projects with field association schemes. This will be a temporary API but useful when transitioning from the legacy field configuration APIs to the new ones.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The starting index of the returned projects. Base index: 0.
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of projects to return per page, maximum allowed value is 100.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: List of project ids to filter the results by.
parameters.name: projectId

200.description: Returns the list of project with field association schemes.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

404.description: Returned if the feature flag is disabled.
